stage_evidence.source_mesh: 2754 vertices / 5504 faces, 0 boundary edges, watertight, winding-consistent, positive volume.
stage_evidence.offset_body_after_repair: P02 and P03 are watertight with 0 boundary edges and 0 degenerate faces; fix_winding and fix_inversion do not create the failure.
stage_evidence.manifold_boolean_native_return: P02 and P03 are is_volume/watertight with 0 boundary edges but each contains 7 degenerate faces.
stage_evidence.clean_mesh: merge_vertices leaves the relevant topology unchanged; nondegenerate_faces(height=1e-12) drops 7 faces and opens exactly 21 edges.
stage_evidence.final_result: P02 and P03 each have one component, 21 boundary edges, are not watertight/is_volume, and are rejected by postassembly QA.
stage_evidence.measurement_semantics: Local operator measurement watertight=1 refers to the pre-clip offset body. Postassembly QA inspects the accepted delivered component and reports NOT_WATERTIGHT. Damage effect realized and physical-result acceptability are separate statuses.

p03_wall_guard.normal_convention: source.face_normals are outward; points + normal*eps begins outside the original source. Casting along -normal therefore returns the nearby entry hit, not the opposite wall exit.
p03_wall_guard.interpretation: The ~0.002 mm source reading is approximately 2 epsilon and supports an immediate source-surface hit. measured_max_recession_mm is assigned from depth*scale; it is not an independent measurement. measured_max_vertex_shift_mm is an observed input/output displacement, but is not a remaining-wall measurement. Only 164/400 rays were paired and unpaired rays are excluded from violation_fraction.
p03_wall_guard.min_wall_contract: P03 MIN_WALL_MM=0.6 is supplied as a guard value, but the acceptance condition uses only the fraction of paired points whose measured local thickness drop exceeds 50%, with a default violation budget of 1%. It does not require min_damaged_mm >= 0.6 mm. Treat the current MIN_WALL geometry proof as invalid until a valid measurement and explicit coverage policy exist.
p03_wall_guard.do_not_flip_sign: Simply starting at point - normal*eps is not a valid repair: after erosion, the source sample can be outside the damaged solid, so first hit measures entry/recession depth rather than remaining wall.
required_measurement_properties: Use common material rays/paired source and output entry-exit intervals, or a validated corresponding inner/outer wall map.
Handle no-hit, multiple intervals, grazing incidence, roughness-adjacent intersections, and source/output correspondence explicitly.
Report paired and ambiguous coverage; fail or mark UNKNOWN below a declared coverage threshold instead of discarding invalid samples and passing.
Keep displacement/effect realization evidence separate from the minimum remaining-wall geometry guard.

resolution_and_physics_limits.interpretation: These are per-vertex surface-offset operations, not voxel-grid-resolved fields. A requested sub-edge displacement can move existing vertices, but that alone provides neither independently measured local wall survival nor mesh convergence or physical crack validation. A t/h ratio around 8 at h=0.5 mm is only a candidate sampling condition, not a universal physical sufficiency rule.

routing_and_spacing.selected_route: The diagnostic log shows the narrowband declared route assertions pass for P02/P04 before details-schema assertions fail.

routing_and_spacing.P03_spacing_details: details.narrowband.spacing exists with spacing_mm 0 and basis SURFACE_OPERATOR.
routing_and_spacing.P04_spacing_details: sdf_pipeline.spacing has spacing_mm 0 and basis ANALYTIC_CUTTER; details.narrowband.spacing is absent.
routing_and_spacing.explicit_budget_semantics: Honoring 0.5701 mm may exceed the node budget; the contract says report the cost rather than silently alter the explicit value. Do not interpret budget_limited=false as proof an explicit grid fits.

algorithm_options_for_main_review.option: Native Manifold Mesh64 with preserved native output and strict geometry/topology QA.
algorithm_options_for_main_review.evidence: Installed manifold3d exposes Mesh64, a Manifold(Mesh64) overload, and to_mesh64(); Mesh64 accepts float64 vertex properties and uint64 triangle indices. The currently inspected Trimesh adapter casts vertices to float32 and returns to_mesh().
algorithm_options_for_main_review.risk: Manifold construction documentation indicates degenerate triangles may be collapsed; higher precision is available but may not eliminate coplanar/collinear Boolean degeneracy. This option was API/source inspection only; no candidate was run.

algorithm_options_for_main_review.option: Avoid the post-clip Boolean only when exact containment and self-intersection predicates prove it redundant.
algorithm_options_for_main_review.evidence: The offset body before Boolean is already closed and has no degenerate faces; this fixture’s candidate and accepted volumes differ only by floating point-scale amounts, but sampled containment is not a proof.
algorithm_options_for_main_review.risk: Nonconvex geometry, high curvature, self-intersections, and outside excursions can invalidate an unchecked containment shortcut. Fail closed when proof is unavailable.

algorithm_options_for_main_review.option: Construct/stitch a conforming local patch or re-extract the shared narrow-band field as a whole closed surface.
algorithm_options_for_main_review.evidence: Would avoid retaining untouched triangles across a Boolean seam or produce a globally consistent boundary.
algorithm_options_for_main_review.risk: Highest implementation cost; introduces resolution, local seam, drift, and memory risks and needs independent convergence/volume/topology validation.

recommendation: For a later implementation task, compare the native Mesh64 preservation path and a rigorously proven Boolean-elision path as separate small spikes with unchanged strict QA. If neither yields a valid closed volume, consider conforming patch construction or shared-field whole-surface extraction. Separately redesign P03 thickness evidence before using MIN_WALL as a guard. This report does not select a repair or certify physical validity.
uncertainties: The diagnostic proves the stage where degenerates are dropped and boundary edges appear, but it did not store a one-to-one mapping from each raw degenerate triangle to its resulting collinear edge cycle.
No positive area of any collinear boundary cycle was measured; do not interpret boundary edge counts as seven material holes or cracks.
For legacy global_sdf intersection failures, the traceback does not identify which Boolean operand failed volume validation.
No independent CAD wall-thickness correspondence or crack-growth reference is available in this study.
The P03 route agreement test cannot compare resulting evidence because apply_axis validation aborts first.
